data.name: Parwaz
data.gender_notes: Parwaz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who soars, flies, or travels in the sky. The name Parwaz carries the meaning “Traveler, Soarer, Skyward” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian, Arabic. Parents who choose Parwaz usually hope their child will grow to embody traveler, soarer, skyward and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of spiritual growth, transcendence, and liberation
data.etymology: Parwaz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Traveler, Soarer, Skyward.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Parwaz total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: براوز
in_arabic.meaning: الارتقاء و الصعود إلى مكانة عالية
in_arabic.long_meaning: براوز هو اسم مشتق من الفعل 'برز' الذي يعني الارتقاء و الصعود إلى مكانة عالية. و يدل على الشخص الذي يمتلك قدرة على التطور و التحسين المستمر، و هو اسم ذو دلالة روحية و معنوية عالية في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: پرواز
in_urdu.meaning: اونچی اڑان، بلند پروازی، عظیم المرتبت
in_urdu.long_meaning: پرواز ایک ایسا نام ہے جو فارسی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے اونچی اڑان، بلند پروازی یا عظیم المرتبت۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ روحانی ترقی اور اعلیٰ مقاصد کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: परवाज़
in_hindi.meaning: उच्च उड़ान, महान उद्देश्य, आध्यात्मिक उत्थान
in_hindi.long_meaning: परवाज़ एक ऐसा नाम है जिसका अर्थ है उच्च उड़ान, महान उद्देश्य या आध्यात्मिक उत्थान। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है क्योंकि यह उच्च आदर्शों और आध्यात्मिक विकास की आकांक्षा को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: پرواز
in_pashto.meaning: لوړه الوتنه، عالي هدف، روحاني پرمختګ
in_pashto.long_meaning: پرواز داسې يو نوم دی چې د لوړوالي او عظمت معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو لپاره ځانګړی اهمیت لري ځکه چې دا د روحاني پرمختګ او لوړو اهدافو د لټون څرګندنه کوي.

in_english.name: Parwaz
in_english.long_meaning: Parwaz is a name derived from Persian roots, signifying high flight, exaltation, or spiritual ascension. It holds significant spiritual and cultural importance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing the pursuit of elevated goals and spiritual growth. The name is etymologically linked to Arabic roots, reflecting a broader cultural heritage across Muslim communities.

data.cultural_impact: The name Parwaz has Persian origins and is popular among Muslim communities. In the Islamic description of the Day of Judgment, believers are promised to fly upon miraculous creatures called "Sawab", meaning "clouds" or "sound wings". Therefore, the name can symbolize an individual's aspiration for high intellectual, spiritual, or emotional achievements, an adventurous nature, or a yearning for freedom.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic beliefs, every human being is considered a 'traveler' during their earthly journey. Parwaz can signify a soul's determination to ascend spiritually, reaching heights of enlightenment and closeness to the Divine. The name can also serve as a reminder to constantly strive towards self-improvement and moral growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Traveler, Soarer, Skyward" symbolizes One who soars, flies, or travels in the sky. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Parwaz serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of traveler, soarer, skyward.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Parwaz was a Persian warrior during the Islamic conquests. The name Parwaz carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Parwaz was a prominent figure in the Islamic conquests, serving under various caliphs and commanders. He was known for his bravery and military prowess.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Parwaz remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
